# vaultwarden_organization_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a member of an organization by ID or email. The provider user must be an owner or admin of the organization, or a manager with access to all collections.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a member of an organization by email
data "vaultwarden_organization_user" "by_email" {
  organization_id = "53878c48-51e9-416d-b31a-1b4209c93832"
  email           = "user@example.com"
}

# Or by the ID of the organization user
data "vaultwarden_organization_user" "by_id" {
  organization_id = "53878c48-51e9-416d-b31a-1b4209c93832"
  id              = "0a5f6a36-38e4-4cbb-9a3a-25cbd76de8b5"
}

# Give the user access to a collection
resource "vaultwarden_organization_collection_user" "example" {
  organization_id      = data.vaultwarden_organization_user.by_email.organization_id
  collection_id        = "c3c1d2c5-2f5e-4bb4-9e4b-0e3f3c6f5d52"
  organization_user_id = data.vaultwarden_organization_user.by_email.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email of the user to look up, compared case-insensitively. Exactly one of `id` and `email` must be set
- `id` (String) The ID of the organization user to look up (the membership, not the user account). Exactly one of `id` and `email` must be set

### Read-Only

- `access_all` (Boolean) Whether the user has access to all collections of the organization. Vaultwarden derives it from the type: `Owner` and `Admin` always have it, a `Manager` has it with the *Manage all collections* permission, and a `User` never has it
- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the organization user, `null` when not set
- `name` (String) The name of the user. Vaultwarden only returns it once the user has accepted the invitation, so it is `null` for invited users, and for users without a name
- `status` (String) The status of the user in the organization: `Invited`, `Accepted`, `Confirmed` or `Revoked`
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user has two-step login enabled
- `type` (String) The type of the user in the organization: `Owner`, `Admin`, `User` or `Manager`
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user account. Use it with the `vaultwarden_user` data source
